purpose: M5 repair whole-pipeline regression against the frozen pre-repair production executable text; not a selector-only attribution
candidate: Current repair source, compiled runtime and shared CPU fixture.
control: Retained parent matched-control runtime whose full arm64/x86_64 executable text was previously proved identical to production 095193d11a; runtime hash is verified against that proof.
bucket_scope: Resident CPU/CpuRam partial writes, H=0, one thread, one in-flight operation, diagnostics disabled. Current M5 has no handoff and therefore selects FreshCow for these PreserveContents MutableGuard writes.
metric: Direct completed-operation throughput reported by the fixture as completed_operations / wall_ns. This is not inferred by inverting sampled latency.
comparison: Same fixture executable, repaired versus pre-repair runtime. Candidate/control completed-throughput ratios, combined into adjacent order-balanced blocks; median of 20 blocks with the existing familywise confidence rule.
tolerance: Candidate throughput regression must not exceed 2% in either required bucket: candidate/control >= 0.98.
confidence: For two required buckets, each bucket uses a one-sided 97.5% bootstrap lower bound over the 20 predeclared order-balanced blocks, giving at least 95% familywise confidence by Bonferroni. The statistic is the median block ratio.
run_order: Rotate bucket order by pair. Alternate control/candidate order on successive pairs. Adjacent even/odd pairs form one predeclared order-balanced block. Preserve all samples.
stop_rule: Exactly 40 fresh process pairs (20 adjacent order-balanced blocks) per bucket; no optional stopping, sample deletion, reuse of the earlier failed experiment or rerun replacement. The earlier single-pair analysis remains preserved.
environment: No build, TSAN, profiler or other benchmark runs concurrently. QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen; KIS_CPU_BASELINE_LOOPS=4; KIS_CPU_BASELINE_RATE_MS=750; KIS_BR1_STAGE_PROFILE=0.
secondary_evidence: Preserve process wall time, setup, manager destruction, correctness and loader identity. These are reported but do not replace the selector throughput gate.
limits: Two CPU forced-COW whole-operation repair-regression buckets only. Selector source is unchanged; this comparison is not a new selector-only causal experiment and is not formal upstream BR1-PERF or M6 handoff qualification.
